display.summary: Weather works in generated stacks and is built from Dlux components, and administrators can assign landing pages per user and per group.
highlights: Weather calls OpenWeather from the Celery worker, so city search and readings work where web has no internet access.
Weather settings use the Dlux builder, inspector shell and toggle selectors; the titlebar action floats as a bubble and previews.
With the per-user homepage switch on, administrators assign a landing page in Edit User and in each group; a user's own choice still wins.
